title: GCAP-B: leaf-boosted growing plateaus with collective high-confidence Fourier labels

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), GCAP-B as fully specified in proof.md and cs1_base.md outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 under independent ideal copies. On every execution branch, jointly with the other bounds and tolerance, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^4 2^(a sqrt(n)+(3/5)n^(1/4))). Here , the exact u_333/v_333 of cs1_base.md Section 0. All constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This representative envelope has exact growth index 1/2. The leaf-boosted schedule, collective high-confidence label extraction and acquisition cap are specified in proof.md and replace the original CS1 schedule and verified extraction; there is no fallback cap.

For every N>=2 and s, success is at least 1-2^-8, jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance or maximum possible tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
